license_required.quote: (1) On or after October 1, 2006, no person shall engage in the business of money transmission in this state without a license, or without being an agent of a licensee, as provided in this subtitle.

bond_structure.quote: The commissioner may increase the amount of the surety bond, or other similar security, to a maximum of five million dollars ($5,000,000), upon the basis of the financial condition of an applicant, as evidenced by net worth, transaction volume, or other relevant criteria that the commissioner may establish by order or rule.

bond_min_usd.quote: (1) Each application shall be accompanied by a surety bond or other similar security acceptable to the commissioner, in the amount of at least five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000).

net_worth_structure.quote: Each licensee under this subtitle shall at all times have a net worth of not less than five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000), calculated in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.

net_worth_min_usd.quote: Each licensee under this subtitle shall at all times have a net worth of not less than five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000), calculated in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.

application_fee_usd.quote: Each application shall be accompanied by a nonrefundable application fee in the amount of five hundred dollars ($500) and a nonrefundable license fee of five hundred dollars ($500) if application is made on or before March 31, or the next business day if March 31 falls on a weekend or holiday.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: (1) A licensee under this subtitle shall pay an annual renewal fee of five hundred dollars ($500) no later than September 20 of each year.

decision_days.quote: (2) The commissioner shall approve, or deny in writing, every completed application for a license within one hundred twenty (120) days from the date a complete application is submitted, which period may be extended for good cause by the commissioner.
